name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop — Electron shell wrapping the dsh web UI with auto-update
author: dsh-desktop

scripts.dist: npm run build:ts && node scripts/pack-engine.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:ts && node scripts/pack-engine.mjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.publish: npm run build:ts && node scripts/pack-engine.mjs && electron-builder --publish always
